description: This PHP class 'PurgeCandidateModel' resides in a Human Resource Management system. It defines a data model used in the maintenance API to represent a candidate that is to be purged, identified by 'vacancyId'. The class implements serialization through the 'Normalizable' interface, allowing it to be converted to an array for API responses.

classes.name: PurgeCandidateModel
classes.description: A model class representing a purge candidate with a vacancy ID, designed for API serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a specific vacancy ID.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the object to an array suitable for API responses, showing the vacancyId within a 'purged' property.
